 ‘Mission: Cross 2’ Sets December 2026 Netflix Release After Delay
 Netflix has confirmed a new December 2026 release window and four major cast additions for its highly anticipated action sequel.
 By Jacob Robinson  •  @JRobinsonWoN 
 November 20th, 2026 - 10:12 am 
 Picture: Mission: Cross 2 – Netflix
 Mission: Cross will return with a sequel on Netflix in December 2026! The sequel was previously scheduled for release earlier this year, but no reason was given for the delay. Hwang Jung Min and Yeom Jung Ah return to reprise their roles as Park Gang Mu and Kang Mi Seon. Here’s everything we know about Mission Cross 2 on Netflix. 
 Mission Cross 2 is an upcoming South Korean Netflix Original directed and written by Lee Myung Hoon. The film is produced by Obra Creative.
 × Subscribe to our Newsletter Get the latest Netflix news, reviews, and releases in your inbox.
 Subscribe 
 When is Mission Cross 2 coming to Netflix?
 Mission: Cross 2 was previously scheduled for a Q3 2026 (July-September) release, but for some unknown reason it was delayed.
 A recent update confirms that Mission: Cross 2 will be coming to Netflix in December 2026.
 However, without a confirmed release date, there’s always a chance that the film could arrive in early 2027.
 What is the plot of Mission Cross 2 ?
 The synopsis has been sourced from Netflix:
 Kang-mu is a former special ops agent enjoying a quiet life after the events of Mission: Cross. But peace doesn’t last long when the President calls on him to recover a stolen national treasure, pulling him and his wife, Mi-seon, into their most dangerous mission yet. Mi-seon, a former Asian Games shooting silver medalist, turned skilled detective. After a sudden demotion to a seaside provincial station, Mi-seon seizes the chance to return to action — and teaming up with her husband once again means sparks will fly both on and off the field. 
 Who are the cast members of Mission Cross 2 ?
 Netflix has officially confirmed that Hwang Jung Min and Yeom Jung Ah will return to reprise their roles as Park Gang Mu and Kang Mi Seon.
 Picture: Hwang Jung Min (left) Yum Jung Ah (right)
 Jeong Man Sik will return to reprise his role as Lee Sang Ung. So far, the actor has starred in Netflix dramas Café Minamdang , Chief of Staff , and Vagabond . Other cast members confirmed to be reprising their roles are Cha Rae Hyung as Heon Gi and Lee Ho Cheol as Dong Su.
 Joining the cast of Mission Cross 2 are:
 Yoon Kyung Ho (The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call) as Cheon In Hak, who is the head of a shadowy organization targeting cultural treasures
 Im Seong Ja (Hellbound) as Duchil, who is a black-market dealer known as the “connoisseur of the tomb-raiding world.”
 Cha In Pyo (What Happened to Mr. Cha?) as the President who enlists the couple for their mission.
 Kim Kuk Hee (Sweet Home) plays the President’s Chief of Staff.
 Picture left to right: Kim Kuk Hee, Yoon Kyung Ho, Im Seong Jae, and Cha in Pyo
 What is the production status of Mission Cross 2 ?
 Development Filming Scheduled Filming Ongoing Post-Production 
 Pre-production began in September 2025, and production started on October 30, 2025, with costumes and the table read.
 Filming ended sometime in February 2026.
 What is the film’s runtime?
 The film’s runtime is confirmed as  113 minutes .
